diag.txt: Sell and replace: 1 wallet received SOL from a dev / bundle / early-buyer sale and then bought this coin — the same money back in under new wallets; they hold 0.0% now.
Launch check: our tracker saw 15.1% bought in the create block by 3 wallets; this lookup found 26.0% by 4 — more than the tracker (it may have missed a transaction live).
The dev launched it from FaBGrH… but named a different wallet, C5Fezj…, as the coin's creator (that wallet gets the creator fees) — sites that show "dev" usually show the second one.
3 launch wallets took 21.5% while paying almost no SOL — paid in another token, or given the tokens; the SOL figures for them are not what was paid.
GMGN tags 39 holders as bundler or insider; 0 of them are also in our bundle / owner groups.
9 of the early wallets are trading in and out of the coin (3+ buys and 3+ sells) — volume farming or flipping.
The dev has launched 47 other coins (5 in the last 24 h), 2 graduated, best $23K (our tracker (since 18 Oct; pump.fun did not answer)).
Bundles: GMGN says bundlers bought 32.6% and hold 21.2% now; we measure 29.4% bought together and 0.0% still held.
The dev and bundle's group (6 wallets including wallets linked to them) holds 0.0% now.
Launch bundle 26.0% over 4 wallets.
Dev bought 10.9% and holds none now (sold out).
Bundle wallets: took 15.1% in the create block, hold 0.0% now; 3 of 3 sold out.
The first 60 buyers after the dev and bundle (all within 9 s of launch) bought 54.2%; together with the dev and bundle 0 wallets still hold 0.0%. Fresh: 2 of 64 checked, holding 0.0%.
The early wallets sent tokens to 4 other wallets; they hold nothing now (sold or passed on).
Selling: the early wallets have sold 52.3% of supply so far, 0.0% of it in the last hour (1 wallet).
28 of the early wallets are whales (50+ SOL or $10K+ in tokens), holding 0.0% now.
Snipers (4 blocks after the create): 5 took 7.3%, hold 0.0% now.
Top 10 holders (pool and curve left out) hold 14.9%; the largest 2.2%.
The bundle's first sales were at about $56K–$58K market cap (today's SOL price).
50 funders are busy, exchange-like wallets; wallets that share only that funder were not grouped together.
